summary: feat(design-tokens): map spacing, radius, type and shadows to Nova
description:
Because:
 - FXA-14256 moves FxA's non-color Tailwind tokens onto Acorn behind the novaDesignSystem flag.

This commit:
 - Points spacing, radius and font-weight steps that match Acorn at its vars; other steps keep Tailwind defaults.
 - Maps shadows to --box-shadow-level-1..4, font-body/header to --font-family, card headers to --font-weight-heading.
 - Adds today's values for these tokens to legacy.css so flag-off and admin-panel are unchanged.
 - Resolves var() values in the Storybook Spacing page and repoints the Typography page's font link.
 - Documents the token mapping and the opacity rule in the design-tokens README.

Fixes FXA-14256
